class.name: AgentInspector
class.brief_description: Explains where saved property values come from, and who uses a scene or resource.
class.description: Answers questions such as "why does this door have collision layer 4?" by listing every saved layer that sets a property, highest priority first: this scene, then inherited and instanced scenes, then the script default, then the class default. Values set by scripts at runtime can't be traced; [method explain_property] reports the live value next to the saved one. Used by [code]--explain-property[/code], [code]--find-overrides[/code] and [code]--resource-users[/code].

method.name: capture
method.description: Saves the last rendered frame of the main window to [param path] as a PNG, resized by [param scale], plus a [code].json[/code] file next to it. Returns [code]path[/code], [code]frame[/code], [code]size[/code], [code]renderer[/code] and [code]camera[/code] (node, position, forward direction, fov and clip planes for 3D; position and zoom for 2D), or [code]error[/code]. Needs real rendering: run with [code]--offscreen[/code], not [code]--headless[/code]. Relative paths are relative to the directory the command was run from.

method.name: explain_property
method.description: Explains [param property] on a live [param node] using the scene file it was loaded from, and adds [code]runtime_value[/code] and [code]changed_at_runtime[/code].

method.name: explain_scene_property
method.description: Explains [param property] on the node at [param node_path] (relative to the root, [code]"."[/code] for the root) in the scene file [param scene]. Returns a [Dictionary] with [code]value[/code], [code]layers[/code] (each with [code]value[/code], [code]source[/code] and [code]kind[/code]) and optional [code]notes[/code], or [code]error[/code].

method.name: find_overrides
method.description: Lists every scene that instances or inherits [param scene], and the properties each one overrides, including overrides of child nodes through editable children.

method.name: format_explain
method.description: Formats a result from [method explain_scene_property] as a short report; the winning layer is marked with [code]>[/code].

method.name: pick
method.description: Returns what is under [param position] in [param viewport] (the main window if [code]null[/code]): [code]control[/code] for UI, then [code]object[/code] for the 3D or 2D physics shape hit (with [code]hit_position[/code]), or [code]object = null[/code] if nothing is there. For a [SubViewportContainer], or a [TextureRect] showing a [ViewportTexture] (e.g. a low-resolution world scaled up, even with its mouse filter set to ignore, reported as [code]screen[/code]), [code]inside[/code] holds the result of picking inside that viewport.

method.name: resource_users
method.description: Lists every scene or resource file that references [param resource], with the node properties that use it.
